planSteps.description: Click on 'Domicilio normal' option in step 0
Click on the origin barrio search input and type 'Sur'
Select the first option with 'Sur' in the name from the dropdown
Click on the destination barrio search input and type 'Norte'
Select the first option with 'Norte' in the name from the dropdown
Enter 'Avenida 5 # 30-40' in the origin direction field
Enter 'Carrera 20 # 25-35' in the destination direction field
Enter '600000' in the transferencia monto field
The price summary section should show a 'Tarifa base' line with a value greater than 0
The price summary section should show a line with text 'Entre 31 a 45 kg' and value '$ 5.000' (peso recargo for 50kg)
The price summary section should show a line with text 'Más de $500.000' and value '$ 4.000' (transferencia recargo for $600k)
The total at the bottom should be the sum of tarifa base + $5.000 (peso) + $4.000 (transferencia)
